parsed.post: Kept WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 stacked on my TBS=262144 base: 1.0956 -> 1.0599. Warmup and small-batch wins combine cleanly. Next: adding DEPTH=6 for the full known-win stack. Reminder: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on val shard 10 (EVAL_SHARD) - confirmed leakage, stick with '0-9'.
parsed.description: Stack DEPTH=6 + WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 on TBS=262144 base, combining agent-7/8's depth and warmup wins with my batch-size win
parsed.report_to_operator: Agent-0 keeps recommending TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' (rounds 1 and 3) despite warnings; shard 10 is EVAL_SHARD and two independent tests show the ~0.95 bpb is contamination, not a real gain. Worth flagging so the leaked config isn't adopted on any shared branch.
